about: Data for progress/make_progress.py. After every DEV: add its entry to `devs`, update `roadmap` if a milestone was promoted, then run `python3 progress/make_progress.py`.

roadmap.reached_rule: up to the last promoted release, v0.4.0-alpha.7.9 (alpha 7.8 delivered 0.4.7 and 0.4.8); alpha 8 = 0.4.9 (project owner); except those listed as open

open.0.3.5: generalization to unseen data is not yet shown (ROADMAP.md)

roadmap.in_progress_note: not promoted; closure check passed, promotion is the owner's call

alpha8_plan.note: update `validated` only when a pre-registered gate for that target passes
alpha8_plan.evidence_note: DEV21–DEV28 each passed held-out gates in a lab (DEV24 and DEV28 also with wrong labels), and DEV30 all of them together; on real bugs, learned knowledge repaired 1 of the 2 needed (DEV29), 0 on 75 fresh bugs once given its own time (DEV31), and 2 of 143 fresh bugs with 2 extra wrong patches (DEV32); the project's own tests as an acceptance check halved the wrong patches on 48 fresh bugs (DEV33 G33-A passed), with 1 learned-only repair; with the check fixed, 0 on 59 fresh bugs (DEV34), and a project's own earlier fixes add none; three family mechanisms are defaults

devs.title: Repair beyond single sites
devs.gate: G1: wrong patches accepted on fresh faults stay within the bound
devs.result: passed: 0 of 18 accepted patches wrong; real bugs: 4 of 83 repaired correctly
devs.why_not_promoted: fixed in advance: the real-bug corpus has 83 bugs, below the bar of 100

devs.title: A learning engine and a data pipeline
devs.gate: pre-registered study; needs generated data from the user's PC

devs.title: ASM learns its own repair procedures
devs.gate: G17-1: real bugs only a learned procedure fixes

devs.title: Learned fix shapes, content from the problem
devs.gate: G18-1: fresh fixes only learned shapes reproduce

devs.title: More training data, same system
devs.gate: G19-1: fresh fixes only learned knowledge reproduces

devs.title: Learned edit steps that combine
devs.gate: G20-1: fresh fixes only learned steps reproduce

devs.title: Sharing a candidate budget between learned sources
devs.gate: G21-A: no interference between learned families, held out
devs.result: passed: relevant + unrelated donors 0.000 → 1.000 on 3 new structures (144 paired attempts, no wrong answer); Part B on learned steps not passed (2 gained, 0 lost)

devs.title: Learned families for two-input targets
devs.gate: G22-A: families transfer to held-out two-input tasks
devs.result: passed: relevant donors 0.229 → 0.993 on 3 new two-input structures (110 vs 0 paired), no wrong answer, no loss on affine targets

devs.title: Learned families over other input names
devs.gate: G23-A: families transfer across input names, either role order, held out
devs.result: passed: donors over other names 0.021 → 0.990 on 3 new two-input structures (279 vs 0 paired), both role orders, no wrong answer, no loss on exact-name or affine targets

devs.title: Three-input transfer across names, and wrong labels
devs.gate: G24-A/B: six role orders on three inputs; wrong labels cost only their own attempts
devs.result: passed: donors over other names 0.000 → 0.979 on 3 new three-input structures, all six role orders (846 vs 0 paired); labels wrong at 0.10 cost exactly the corrupted attempts; no wrong answer

devs.title: Solving family parameters from the fit examples
devs.gate: G25-A: constants beyond the grid and the budget's reach, no loss, held out
devs.result: passed: beyond the −8..8 grid 0.000 → 0.982 (212 vs 0 paired), beyond the budget's reach 0.000 → 1.000 (54 vs 0), no loss, half the evaluator calls, no wrong answer

devs.title: Asking which family candidate is right
devs.gate: G26-A: one question recovers ambiguous fits, no loss, held out
devs.result: passed: degenerate fits 0.817 → 0.991 (150 vs 0 paired), standard fits 0.984 → 1.000, role order no longer matters, 0.03 questions per ordinary attempt, no wrong answer

devs.title: A family memory past 32 procedures that survives restarts
devs.gate: G27-A: transfer with 48 and 120 background procedures and after a restart, held out
devs.result: passed: relevant donors 0.000 → 1.000 with 48 and 120 background procedures (288 vs 0 paired each), unchanged after reopening, no false transfer, no wrong answer

devs.title: Tolerating one contradicting label
devs.gate: G28-A: transfer under wrong labels rises, no wrong answer, held out
devs.result: passed: wrong labels at 0.05 0.102 → 0.579, at 0.10 0.009 → 0.181 (168 vs 0 paired), clean 0.999 → 0.986, no false transfer, no wrong answer

devs.title: Learned repair knowledge on real bugs, where fault localization points
devs.gate: G29-A: real bugs repaired correctly only with learned knowledge (person-read), with no loss and no extra wrong patch

devs.title: An M4-candidate battery of the whole transfer stack
devs.gate: G30-A: the four opt-in transfer mechanisms together, under every lab condition at once, held out
devs.result: passed: all transfer conditions 0.324 → 0.889 (1,064 vs 7 paired); far constants, 60 background procedures and restart 0 → 1.000; wrong labels 0.111 → 0.573; ambiguous fits 0.997 → 0.976; no false transfer, no wrong answer

devs.title: Phase 3 on its own clock, on fresh real bugs
devs.gate: G31-A: fresh real bugs repaired correctly only with learned knowledge, even against the same total time

devs.title: A guard against test-copied patches, on freshly mined real bugs
devs.gate: G32-B: fresh real bugs repaired correctly only with learned knowledge, with at most 1 extra wrong patch (G32-A, the guard, not passed either)

devs.title: The project's own test suite as an acceptance check, on fresh real bugs
devs.gate: G33-A: the check halves learned knowledge's wrong patches on fresh real bugs, keeps its correct repairs, costs ≤ 5% of real fixes
devs.result: G33-A passed: wrong learned patches 4 → 2 on 48 fresh bugs, both correct repairs kept, 1 of 48 developer fixes rejected (2.1%); G33-B not passed: 1 learned-only correct repair of 2 needed, one run 478 s (limit 360)

devs.title: Project adaptation (development) and the M4 real-data gate with the fixed check
devs.gate: G34-A: fresh real bugs repaired correctly only with learned knowledge, with the fixed acceptance check

devs.title: Causal repair by intervention (development only)
devs.gate: none: stopped in development, not pre-registered
devs.result: not run: on 229 seen bugs, 13 plausible edits, 1 equal to the developer's fix (already repaired); the rest are wrong

devs.title: Stage 4 closure check (main roadmap)
devs.gate: G49: full ≥ .8 of oracle, hazard ≤ .05, every component contributes
devs.result: passed on 30 held-out worlds: .937 of the oracle's score, hazard .028; removing any component costs reward or safety
